Subject: MAP draft + evaluation cadence (Novum)

Elena —

Thanks again for the time today. Attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP_Novum_v3.xlsx) and a draft SOW that lays out a 3-week evaluation (POC) followed by a staged commit if the POC meets the success criteria. High-level proposed cadence: 

- Week 0: Contract & security review (SOC2 evidence attached in the map)
- Week 1–3: POC: 2 models, 1 production pattern, perf and cost benchmarks
- Week 4: POC review -> decision gate
- Week 5–8: Ramp: initial commit (flexed based on usage)

Pricing/commits note: we can offer a time-limited evaluation credit and a staged commit discount schedule tied to committed throughput. We also model a renewal uplift mechanism at the 12-month mark that can be triggered by usage growth or feature expansion — happy to outline specifics below.

Please review the MAP and the SOW draft. If you’re comfortable, we can schedule a short call next week to lock the commit trigger points and pricing bands.

Attachments: MAP_Novum_v3.xlsx, SOW_draft_v1.pdf (see sheet: pricing & milestones)

Best,
Priya Natarajan

Priya —

Thanks for the MAP and SOW. The timeline looks reasonable; a couple of questions before we book the sync: 

1) Can you provide a simple tiered pricing view tied to quarterly committed token volumes? Specifically we need (a) POC/initial ramp price (b) sustained commit bands (50k, 200k, 1M tokens/day) and (c) a renewal uplift schedule if our usage grows 30%+ year-over-year.
2) For the renewal uplift mechanism: will you provide an annual review window and a cap on the year-over-year uplift percentage? We need to model worst-case finance scenarios.
3) Security asks: we will share an updated security questionnaire; can you confirm who on your side will handle artifact delivery and SOC2 evidence?

Carlos and I are available Tue/Wed afternoon next week for a 30-min sync.

Date: 2027-01-07T08:37:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP draft + evaluation cadence (Novum) — pricing & renewal asks (internal)

Marissa / Aditya —

Forwarding Novum's questions. Short ask: we should propose a clean tiered pricing PDF tied to committed tokens/day and include an explicit renewal uplift guardrail (e.g., annual review window + cap at 15% YoY unless there is a material change in model mix). My recommended play: 

- POC credit: 25k tokens free (applied to first month)
- Ramp pricing: 20% off list for first 3 months after commit at 50k/day equivalent
- Commit bands: 50k/day (base), 200k/day (-30% unit pricing vs base), 1M/day (-45% vs base)
- Renewal uplift: annual review with optional 6-month reprice if usage grows >30%; cap uplift at 15% YoY except for changes in feature set or model premium add-ons

We need EE sign-off on the cap and whether the runtime team can guarantee the fallback plan (compatible model variant) if capacity constraints arise during ramp. Aditya, do we have a recommended fallback variant and quantization profile we should offer Novum to keep unit cost stable during scale?

I’ll draft the pricing table and the updated MAP sheet and send to Elena — want to make sure we’re aligned before external.

Thanks,
Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.inference>

Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@novum.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-01-10T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: MAP v3: pricing bands, commit triggers & renewal uplift (revised)

Elena / Carlos —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal alignment, attached is the revised MAP (MAP_Novum_v3.xlsx) and an updated SOW (SOW_draft_v2.pdf). Key points summarized below so you can share with finance/ops: 

1) Evaluation (POC) — 3 weeks
   - Success criteria: latency <= 200ms p95 on 5k concurrent tokens/day simulation; accuracy thresholds on NLU eval (shared testset)
   - POC credit: 25k token credit applied to first invoice

2) Commit bands & pricing (unit price per 1k tokens):
   - Base (no commit): $0.012/token equivalent (list)
   - Commit Band A (50k tokens/day avg): 20% off list
   - Commit Band B (200k/day avg): 35% off list
   - Commit Band C (1M/day avg): 50% off list
   - Ramp concession: additional 10% off the first month of committed billing to absorb onboarding costs

3) Commit triggers & cadence:
   - Post-POC decision gate (Week 4). If passed, Novum signs initial 6-month commit that scales to Band A after 30 days of observed usage.
   - Auto-escalation: if 30-day trailing usage consistently exceeds commit band by >=25%, we move to the next band with 30 days notice (customer can opt-out within the notice window).

4) Renewal & uplift mechanics:
   - Annual review window: 60 days before renewal effective date.
   - Uplift trigger: sustained YoY growth >30% or significant model mix changes.
   - Uplift cap: 15% YoY except when adding premium models/features (e.g., large-context variants).
   - Right to renegotiate mid-term: permitted at 6 months if usage exceeds 2x initial commit; either party can request reprice with 30-day notice.

5) Security & evidence delivery: Laura will coordinate SOC2 artifacts and evidence delivery (Hub link included).

Attachments: MAP_Novum_v3.xlsx (pricing & milestones sheet), SOW_draft_v2.pdf
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/78921
DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/DocuSignLink-78921

Please let us know if you want the pricing presented as an annual committed spend view instead of tokens/day — happy to convert. If this looks good, can we lock a 30-min signoff call on Tue 1/12 2pm PT?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@novum.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@novum.ai>
Date: 2027-01-12T17:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP v3: pricing bands, commit triggers & renewal uplift (revised)

Priya —

Appreciate the thorough update and the clear activation path. Two quick asks before we lock: 

1) Novum would like a clause that guarantees a one-time 6-month review window after go-live to address any unforeseen uplift pressure; during that window we request a temporary 10% volume credit if actual unit costs increase due to model mix changes (applied as a line-item credit).
2) On the uplift cap: finance agrees to a 15% YoY cap but asks for a floor that if usage drops >20% yoy the effective price cannot be increased (i.e., symmetric protection).

If you accept these measurables we can sign the SOW and move to DocuSign on Tue. We’ll plan for the signoff call Tue 1/12 2pm PT.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.

-Elena
Head of Platform Partnerships, Novum AI
